section: 1/1/20251/1/2027Enacted by Chapter 35, 2024 General Session2024Report to Department of Agriculture and Food of illegal cannabinoid product.If the commission suspects that a cannabinoid product is being sold in the state in violation of a law other than a law described in this chapter, the commission shall report the name and tax identification number of the seller and the cannabinoid product:to the Department of Agriculture and Food; andwithin 30 days after the day on which the commission becomes aware of the sale.
